mentions.name: Bird name-to-picture matching game
mentions.description: A companion matching game that uses the same list of locally reported birds and challenges players to match each bird's name to its picture.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also made a matching game that uses the same list and you have to match the name to a picture of the bird.
